title: Quantum channel tomography: optimal bounds and a Heisenberg-to-classical phase transition
summary: How many black-box queries to a quantum channel are needed to learn its full classical description? This question lies at the heart of quantum channel tomography (also known as quantum process tomography), a fundamental task in the characterization and validation of quantum hardware. Despite extensive prior work, the optimal query complexity for quantum channel tomography is far from fully understood.
